title: ETH Postdoctoral Fellowships
field: All research fields at ETH Zurich

compensation.value: Salary (100%, ETH standards) plus CHF 12,000 per year for research expenses
compensation.evidence_quote: the fellowship covers the fellow's salary (100%, based on ETH standards)

about: ETH Zurich's two-year postdoctoral fellowship for early-career researchers, applied for jointly with an ETH host professor. It covers the fellow's salary at ETH standards plus CHF 12,000 per year for research expenses. Calls close 1 March and 1 September, 17:00 Swiss time.
requirements: Doctorate by the submission deadline (or within six months of it), obtained at most two years before the deadline
At least one peer-reviewed journal publication or a prize for the doctoral thesis

Mobility rules: no more than twelve months in Switzerland, and no more than six months at ETH Zurich, EPFL, PSI, WSL, Empa, Eawag or the University of Zurich, in the three years before the deadline; ETH/UZH doctorates ineligible
Joint application with an ETH host professor via the eResearch system; all parts, including reference letters, in English

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
why: "All research fields at ETH Zurich" → "Use AI to explore, organize, and structure information collected from multiple documents or professional sources."

"At least one peer-reviewed journal publication or a prize for the doctoral thesis" → "Summarize long or complex materials while preserving the main arguments, evidence, conclusions, and important contextual details."

"Joint application with an ETH host professor via the eResearch system" → "Transform complex information into research briefs, comparison matrices, executive summaries, and actionable recommendations."
